page.overview:
What is Greedent?

Greedent is a small Pokémon that resembles an obese red squirrel. It has reddish-tan fur with darker red-brown fur on its bloated belly, ear tips, underside, and the lower half of its face. It has black eyes, light tan markings around its eyes, an orange nose, orange ear insides, a buck tooth, and fluffy cheeks with orange "freckles" on them. It also has stubby limbs and a huge, fluffy tail that it uses to store berries. Although quadrupedal, it is able to stand on its hind legs.

True to their name, Greedent are extremely greedy and gluttonous (hence their plump physique). They store so many berries in their tails that they never notice when they lose them. They're also slow-witted and have a habit of attacking people that shake berry trees too much.

Greedent have powerful teeth which can crack open even the hardest of nuts. As they, like their pre-evolutions, are capable of learning Belch, it would seem that they produce large amounts of digestive gas.

Greedent mainly diet on nuts and Berries.
